# Datadog Alarm Requirements Quality Checklist: Scaffolder Datadog Alarm Baseline

**Purpose**: Validate that Datadog alarm scaffolding requirements are complete, clear, consistent, and measurable before implementation and review.
**Created**: 2026-10-19
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are requirements defined for how templates provide one or more monitor definitions in a single scaffold run? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK002 Are all required monitor-definition fields fully enumerated beyond high-level examples? [Completeness, Ambiguity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK003 Does the spec define the minimum data that each alarm provisioning result must include? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements explicit for templates marked as baseline-required when the alarm list is empty? [Coverage, Edge Case, Spec §FR-008, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK005 Is "complete metric monitor definition" quantified with objective, field-level criteria? [Clarity, Ambiguity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK006 Is "clear reason" for failure output defined with required message structure and detail level? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK007 Is "one platform-configured Datadog account" mapped to explicit configuration ownership and source? [Clarity, Dependency, Spec §FR-009, Plan §Summary]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK008 Do per-alarm outcome requirements align with step-failure requirements when one alarm fails? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK009 Do duplicate-name edge-case expectations align with idempotent upsert semantics keyed by project identity and alarm name? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK010 Are assumptions about a standard baseline set consistent with the clarification that authors provide complete definitions? [Consistency, Assumption, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §Assumptions]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK011 Can SC-002 be objectively measured with a defined data source and time window? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK012 Is SC-004 measurable with a defined baseline method for "manual setup time"? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK013 Are all success criteria traceable to specific functional requirements without orphan outcomes? [Traceability, Spec §Requirements, Spec §Success Criteria]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK014 Are requirements complete across primary, alternate, and invalid-definition flows for single and multi-alarm submissions? [Coverage, Spec §User Stories 1-3]
- [ ] CHK015 Are requirements explicit for mixed-validity submissions where one alarm is invalid and others are valid? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Spec §User Story 3]
- [ ] CHK016 Are requirements defined for how users identify created alarm references after successful scaffolding? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK017 Are requirements defined for duplicate alarm names within one scaffold request (allow/reject/transform)? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK018 Are requirements defined for unavailable Datadog authorization context before API interaction starts? [Edge Case, Recovery, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK019 Are retry boundaries and idempotent create-or-update outcomes defined? [Edge Case, Risk, Spec §FR-007]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK020 Are performance expectations specified for processing multiple monitor definitions in one scaffold step? [Gap, Non-Functional]
- [ ] CHK021 Are auditability requirements defined for who or what created each alarm definition outcome? [Gap, Non-Functional, Traceability]
- [ ] CHK022 Are security requirements defined for Datadog credential handling and least-privilege scopes? [Completeness, Non-Functional, Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK023 Are external dependency requirements for Datadog API availability and rate limiting explicitly documented? [Dependency, Gap]
- [ ] CHK024 Is behavior defined when required platform Datadog configuration is missing or malformed? [Dependency, Recovery, Gap]
- [ ] CHK025 Are out-of-scope lifecycle operations bounded clearly to prevent conflicting interpretation during review? [Boundary, Spec §Assumptions]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK026 Is retry behavior consistent with the constitution's idempotent-outcome requirement and the defined monitor identity? [Consistency, Constitution §II, Spec §FR-007, Plan §Constraints]
- [ ] CHK027 Is "requires baseline monitoring" defined consistently across template authoring, validation, and scaffold execution expectations? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK028 Is the requirement/acceptance-criteria ID scheme sufficient for downstream traceability into implementation and review artifacts? [Traceability, Spec §Requirements, Spec §Success Criteria]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
